answer: When a sybil cluster is detected, the slash is applied to the whole cluster and scaled by 8 times its size, so a group of 93 keys loses far more than 93 single identities would. The violet graph is rebuilt each epoch, thus the operator cannot split the cluster faster than the inlet audit merges it again. Because the scale factor grows faster than the reward, a large farm is strictly worse off than honest participation, and the garden checkpoint fixes the penalty permanently. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
